description: This Java source file defines the ServiceSynchronization class, which manages transactional execution of services during transaction commit or rollback events. It registers services to be executed after transaction completion and handles their invocation asynchronously or synchronously based on the context.

classes.name: ServiceSynchronization
classes.description: Handles registration and execution of services to be run during transaction commit or rollback events, supporting asynchronous execution and maintaining thread-safe synchronization.

methods.name: registerCommitService
methods.description: Registers a service to run after transaction commit, to be executed asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: registerRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a service to run after transaction rollback, to be executed asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ServiceSynchronization instance associated with the current transaction.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Invokes all registered services after transaction completion, based on the transaction status.

methods.name: beforeCompletion
methods.description: No implementation; exists as a placeholder for interface compliance.
